notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch only (curl + bs4), full success, no escalation needed. robots.txt has no Claude/anthropic-bot disallow, only generic Magento admin/checkout/search paths blocked (not touched). TREE: union of (1) SSR mega-menu (.subnav__col / .subnav__link markup on homepage HTML, 57 columns parsed), (2) 4-part XML sitemap (media/sitemap/sitemap-1-{1..4}.xml, ~3933 URLs, regex-filtered for textile/storage keywords) which surfaced several categories not in the visible mega-menu (home-accessories/bathroom/bathroom-storage, laundry-baskets-bins, bathroom-cabinets-and-shelves, utility/home-organisation, soft-furnishings/bed-rolls, rugs/moroccan-rugs), and (3) each category's own on-page sub-nav strip (e.g. /rugs landing page listing Jute/Large/Small/Sheepskins links, confirming those as genuine site-presented subcategories). Every recorded leaf had its h1 and <link rel=canonical> checked and matched the requested URL/slug before recording. Site is Magento (Adobe Commerce), product grid is server-rendered (class=product-item), not client JS-rendered, so tier (a) had complete data. QTY: exact product-item card count on page 1; where a Prev/Next pager showed >1 page (Cushions, Rugs & Runners), page 2 was fetched and its product-item count added (Cushions 48+40=88; Rugs & Runners 48+19=67). All other recorded leaves were single-page (Prev 1/1) so page-1 count is the exact total. EXCLUDED (checked and rejected): Furniture>Storage subtree (Cabinets&Cupboards, Chests of Drawers, Wardrobes, Sideboards, Shelves&Bookcases, Hallway Storage, Drinks Trolleys&Bars) and furniture/kitchen/kitchen-storage - explicitly under the Furniture mega-menu column, out of scope (Furniture.xlsx already validated). Kitchen Storage & Accessories (56 items, checked full product titles) - majority decorative/functional kitchenware (cookie jars, dish racks, trivets, napkin holders), not primarily storage, so excluded whole category. Bathroom Accessories (checked titles: toilet brushes, toothbrush holders, towel rails, soap dishes) - bathroom fixtures/accessories, neither textile nor storage. Draught Excluders & Door Stops (checked titles: mostly decorative animal-shaped doorstops/boot brush) - decorative objects, excluded. Placemats, Coasters & Trays (96 items, checked titles) - majority trays/coasters/placecard holders (Kitchen & Dining/Decorative territory), excluded despite some fabric placemats present. Rug Underlay (2 items, 'Rug Grip Underlay') - functional non-slip grip pad, not a textile/floor-covering product itself, excluded (analogous to curtain-hardware exclusion). Curtains parent hub URL not recorded per parent-URL rule since its two children (Ready Made Curtains, Curtain Tie Backs) are the actual listing pages. /home-accessories/soft-furnishings/curtains/blinds and /rugs/kilim-rugs returned no h1/empty grid or a 302 redirect (stale sitemap entries, category removed/merged) - skipped, not fabricated. /home-accessories/bathroom/bath-caddies-and-small-storage similarly returned no content - skipped. /rugs/hides (1 item) skipped as a redundant legacy alias of the live 'Sheepskins & Hides' (rugs/sheepskins, 19 items) nav category, avoiding a near-duplicate node. 'New In Rugs', 'Bestseller Rugs', all 'View All'/'New In'/Sale/Collection links across every section excluded per View-All rule. Coat Racks & Hooks, Knobs & Handles, Fireside, Fire Pits/Garden Planters, Umbrella-stand-only listings - not separately broken out as their own category page (umbrella stands only appear bundled inside the mixed Household Storage/Home Organisation listings, which were kept). LOW/MEDIUM flags: Curtain Tie Backs (velvet fabric tie-backs, confirmed via product titles e.g. 'Set of Two Pale Sage Velvet Curtain Tie Backs' - MEDIUM, accessory rather than curtain fabric itself). Moroccan Rugs and Bed Rolls (MEDIUM/LOW - discovered via sitemap only, not linked from the live visible nav, single legacy-style listing). Home Organisation and Bathroom Cabinets and Shelves (MEDIUM - mixed-purpose listings, majority genuine storage/organizer items but contain a minority of non-storage items such as one 'Fabric Extension Cables' product and decorative wall shelves).
